name: web-tilted-footer-card-taped-to-the-page-with-link-columns-and-soon-tags
title: White footer card rotated and held by black tape strips, with link columns and grey 'soon' tags
whatItIs: A pale page where a white rounded footer card is tilted a few degrees and pinned at two corners by black tape, holding a bold logo and short description, three link columns (Resources, Company, Compare) with tiny grey 'soon' pills, and below a copyright line, legal links and two social icons.
whatItMeans: Playful and human; tape and tilt turn a standard footer into a pinned note.
techniques: Tape it down with black strips.
Keep the layout in clean columns.

vocabulary.definition: A card that appears attached by tape strips.
A small pill marking an upcoming link.
A vertical list of footer links.
A container rotated a few degrees.
